# Md. Shakibur Rahaman - BRAND & PERFORMANCE MARKETING ARCHITECT

> Full-Stack Brand & Performance Marketer with 3+ years of quantified results across 7 Core Growth Sectors: Hospitality (5-Star Hotels & Resorts), Luxury Interior Design, Elite Club Memberships, Education Agencies, Executive Recruitment, Travel Operators, and D2C E-Commerce. Bridging high-converting creative psychology with rigorous Meta/Google paid media attribution.

## Verified Key Statistics & Track Record
- **Peak ROAS**: 4.8x – 12.4x across consumer and high-ticket B2B funnels
- **Attributed Pipeline & Revenue**: BDT 35M+
- **Qualified High-Ticket Leads**: 5,000+

## Key Client Blueprints & Case Studies
- **Hotel Sarina Dhaka** (5-Star Festive & Banquet Direct Revenue Engine): 7.8x ROAS, BDT 8.4M revenue, 350K+ Reach leads.
- **Luxury Architectural Design Studio** (High-Ticket Interior Fitout & Renovation Lead Engine): 8.4x ROAS, BDT 14.5M revenue, BDT 14.5M Pipeline leads.
- **Prestige City Club & VIP Lounge** (Exclusive Member Recruitment & VIP Brand Positioning): 6.2x ROAS, 88 Members revenue, 140+ Inquiries leads.
- **Global Education Pathways Agency** (International Student Intake & IELTS Enrollment Funnel): 5.4x ROAS, 72 Enrolled revenue, 420+ Leads leads.
- **Apex Executive Search & Staffing** (Corporate Employer Acquisition & Executive Candidate Funnel): 4.8x ROAS, 18 Contracts revenue, 65 B2B Clients leads.
- **Horizon Luxury Travel & Tours** (Outbound Holiday Package & Visa Booking Surge): 9.1x ROAS, BDT 6.2M revenue, 210+ Booked leads.
- **Aura Luxury Apparel & Lifestyle** (Full-Funnel ROAS Scaling & Cart Recovery Engine): 12.4x ROAS, 1,450 Orders revenue, +64% LTV leads.
